q: detailed analysis of the fall of the Roman Empire
history of the Roman Empire fall
write a detailed analysis of the fall of the roman empire
what caused the fall of the Roman Empire
a: The fall of the Western Roman Empire in 476 CE was caused by multiple interconnected factors. Economic factors included severe inflation from debasing currency, crippling taxes to support the military and bureaucracy, and a declining agricultural base. Germanic tribes (Goths, Vandals, Franks) were pushed into Roman territory by the Huns. The Praetorian Guard destabilized the empire through frequent emperor assassinations. The division of the empire in 395 CE and reliance on barbarian mercenaries weakened central authority. The final blow came when Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in 476 CE.
